items.statement: The fixed upright fcc O2/Ag(111) model has weak adsorption, charge transfer and a substrate-modified molecular moment.
items.expected: The conclusion integrates the four observables and limits inference to the fixed model.

items.statement: The single-molecule calculation supports, but does not alone establish, the full collective monolayer phase-transition mechanism.
items.expected: The report distinguishes direct electronic-structure evidence from the paper's broader monolayer interpretation.
